chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you both deny?
ai.seo_question: What does the verse 'Fabi ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: This recurring refrain, appearing 31 times in Surah Ar-Rahman, is interpreted by Shia scholars as addressing both Jinn and humans, highlighting the dual nature of creation's response to divine favors. It serves as a powerful rhetorical device to underscore the inevitability of gratitude or denial, linking the physical blessings of the world with the spiritual reality of the Hereafter.
